description: A NEW CAMERA ANGLE ON A PICTURE: the camera turns around the subject, label and face kept. horizontal 0-360 (0 front, 90 its right side, 180 behind, 270 its left), vertical -30 (looking up) to 90 (straight down), zoom 0 (wide) to 10 (close). One picture per call; for a video, re-shoot it instead. Paid per megapixel; dryRun returns the price. A real person's photo: Using a real person’s face, likeness or voice confirms you are them or have their consent, take full, unlimited responsibility for its use and will cover any claim against Hermoso (hermoso.ai/terms). Paid plan only; recorded.
